statement: Classic Controller Pro subpage distinguishes the Pro by replacing the original Classic's two variable-travel analog triggers with digital controls. It still describes selectors 0x01/0x02/0x03, default 0x01, with corresponding decoded payload lengths 6/9/8; trigger fields in those formats take endpoint values (0 or 31 for 0x01, 0 or 255 for 0x02/0x03), not a continuous position. All digital button indicators are active low.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Classic Controller Pro > Data Format 0x01/0x02/0x03. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Compare wii-gap-wiibrew-classic-pro-identity and wii-gap-wiibrew-extension-data-format-selector.
